messages:
lina: Thinking out loud — for model pin rollouts, can we adopt staggered activation waves (tenant cohorts) instead of flipping pins all-at-once? Main wins: smaller blast radius, clearer per-wave signal for regressions, and ability to pause. Thoughts?

sam: +1. We need metadata to attribute metrics to a wave, otherwise dashboards will mix cohorts and hide regressions.

praveen: Agreed. Proposal: add lightweight rollout-wave fields to the pin manifest. Minimal first pass: `activation_wave`, `wave_selector`, `parent_pin`, `causal_context`, `activation_reason`. Also `wave_state` (pending/active/paused/rolled_back).

jordyn: Also include `applied_by` and `applied_at` for audit and `wave_ttl` so runtime can auto-unbind stale waves.

praveen: Example manifest snippet: 
```json
{
  "pin_id": "pin_2026-05-03",
  "activation_wave": 1,
  "wave_selector": ["tier:beta", "region:us-west-2"],
  "parent_pin": "pin_2026-04-30",
  "causal_context": "cctx-1234",
  "activation_reason": "canary",
  "wave_state": "pending"
}
```

adele: Telemetry note — we should emit `causal_context` with every request exposure event so metrics can be grouped by wave. Also runtime should emit `wave_exposure_count` once the wave starts (and periodic deltas) so ops can know coverage.

sam: What about selector complexity? We can't list all tenant ids. `wave_selector` should support attribute predicates (label:value) and a sampling fraction for large fleets. E.g. "selector": {"labels": {"tier": "beta"}, "sample_pct": 5}.

lina: Good call. We should formalize selector DSL (labels + sample_pct + explicit tenant list). Keep it small initially.

praveen: Also need an idempotency/causal chain field so if we replay a pin toggle we can tie it to the original wave: `causal_parent_id` + `causal_id`.

jordyn: Migration question — existing pins have no waves. Strategy: default wave 0 = immediate global activation. New fields are opt-in; rollout controller treats missing fields as global. No backfill required.

adele: Ops playbook update: queries to compute regression delta should join on `causal_context` and compute pre/post percentiles per-wave, with minimum exposure threshold (e.g., 1000 requests). I'll write a short checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled activation wave 1 for pin_2026-05-03 at 2026-05-03T18:00Z (triggered by lina)

sam: We should also add `pause_on_error` boolean to automatic waves — if regression crosses X%, auto-pause the next waves. That can be controlled by the rollout policy.

lina: Action items: praveen to draft schema PR + runtime changes; adele to draft telemetry join examples; sam to update rollout playbook with pause_on_error; jordyn to sanity-check selector DSL and backfill guidance. Target: draft PR by EOD Thursday.

praveen: On it — I'll open a WIP PR today with tests and example manifests.

sam: I'll start the playbook edits.

jordyn: Ping me for review once the DSL is stable.

lina: Thanks all :thumbsup: — if nobody objects I’ll start a short RFC follow-up doc referencing the PR.
